title: Statewide Races: Republican vs. Democrat (%)
subtitle: Governor and U.S. Senate use the UNF likely-voter poll (Oct 12–19, n=1,471, ±2.8). Attorney General and CFO use St. Pete Polls for Florida Politics (Oct 5–7, n=836, ±3.4). Agriculture uses the only public poll, Targoz/JMI (Sep 28–Oct 4, n=847).

title: Congressional Districts 13 & 16: Partisan Polls Only (%)
subtitle: No independent public poll exists for either seat. CD 13 shows the Democratic House Majority PAC/Hart poll (Aug 25–27) and the Republican Fabrizio Lee poll (Aug 4–6). CD 16 shows the Democratic-sponsored PPP poll (Oct 1–2, n=530). Treat partisan polls as upper bounds for the sponsor's side.
